## Checklist

- [ ] The branch follows Git Flow (`feature/*`, `fix/*`, `chore/*` or `docs/*` into `develop`; `release/*` or `hotfix/*` into `main`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm test` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (release PRs: moved into a version section)
- [ ] `README.md` updated if the language, CLI or API changed
- [ ] New keywords or built-ins go in `src/keywords.js`, and new error text goes in `src/messages.js`
